levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن سعيد الكوفي

notes: «قراءة» is a mode of transmission (reading to the shaykh), not a name: left out
«كنت عند أبي عبد الله» : Ibn al-Fadl is present at the Imam's place and the Imam speaks and rules in the scene; whether the Imam is the source or only in the scene is unsettled (rule 11)
«فأين ما روي أن الفقيه لا يعيد الصلاة» : «روي» has no transmitter: not a link
